title: Visitor and Bell
author: S. M. Vane
blurb: Sable Vasquez, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
